message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout that turned my family group chat into a lively lifeline! While we were all fumbling for flashlights, my brother was busy sending memes about 'surviving the darkness' and my sister shared her secret stash of snacks. It was a reminder that even in the dark, we can find light in laughter and connection. Plus, I made sure our power banks were charged up for some late-night phone games! How do you keep spirits high during a power outage? 💡
